description: The same red-haired young man sits on a promenade bench eating from a paper cone of chips while a gull watches from the bench beside him. A gull dives at the back of his head and his eyes go wide; two more come in low and he ducks down over the cone. Then he is up and running hard away down the promenade, cone clutched to his chest and head down, with gulls flying after him on both sides, and in the last shot the whole flock is up in the air chasing him along the seafront.

en.question: What is the young man fleeing from?

de.answer: Er flieht vor einem Schwarm Möwen.
de.question: Wovor flieht der junge Mann?

es.answer: Está huyendo de una bandada de gaviotas.
es.question: ¿De qué está huyendo el joven?

fr.answer: Il fuit une nuée de mouettes.
fr.question: Que fuit le jeune homme ?
